# Penelope Social

Penelope Social is a Woodbridge cafe and bar: lunch and dinner, plus drinks, serving Bakehouse sourdough.

Penelope Bakehouse is the Scarborough bakehouse and focacceria.

## Location (Google Business / NAP)

- Name: Penelope Social
- Street: 125 Hawkview Blvd
- Locality: Woodbridge
- Region: ON
- Postal: L4H 2E2
- Country: Canada
- Phone: (905) 607-0606
- Email: info@penelopesocial.com
- Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=125+Hawkview+Blvd%2C+Woodbridge%2C+ON+L4H+2E2

Vaughan is the wider municipality / area served. Woodbridge is the city in titles and addressLocality.

## Hours

Cafe: Monday to Saturday 9am to 3pm, Sunday 8am to 12pm
Bar: Monday to Thursday 5pm to 10pm, Friday to Saturday 5pm to 1am

/sourdough-bakery stays on this site as a Social vs Bakehouse page. Do not 301 it to /about or to penelopebakehouse.com. It is not in the header nav. The homepage bread CTA and that page link to https://penelopebakehouse.com.

## Sister bakery

Penelope Bakehouse, 71 Howden Rd, Scarborough, ON M1R 3C7
https://penelopebakehouse.com
Phone (647) 812-0104
Social serves Bakehouse sourdough. Bakehouse is the Scarborough bakehouse and focacceria.
